title: lathyrus luteus f. cirrhosus
intro: Lathyrus luteus f. cirrhosus, commonly known as Indian pea or flat-pea, is a flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including rheumatism, bronchitis, and skin problems, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus f. cirrhosus include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
